name: traffic-king
eval: (() => { const d = __dbg, c = d.city, P = d.player, E = c.edges, N = c.nodes; let best = null, bd = 1e18; for (const e of E) { if (!/^King Street West/.test(e.name || '')) continue; const a = N[e.a], b = N[e.b]; const mx = (a.x + b.x) / 2 + 2360, mz = (a.z + b.z) / 2 + 312; const q = mx * mx + mz * mz; if (q < bd) { bd = q; best = e; } } const a = N[best.a], b = N[best.b], L = Math.hypot(b.x - a.x, b.z - a.z), ux = (b.x - a.x) / L, uz = (b.z - a.z) / L; const off = (best.hw || 7) + 3.5; P.x = (a.x + b.x) / 2 + uz * off; P.z = (a.z + b.z) / 2 - ux * off; P.y = c.groundAt(P.x, P.z, null); P.heading = Math.atan2(-ux, -uz) + 0.25; P.camYaw = P.heading + Math.PI; P.camPos.set(P.x + Math.sin(P.camYaw) * 4.6, P.y + 1.6, P.z + Math.cos(P.camYaw) * 4.6); })()

name: traffic-pkwy
eval: (() => { const d = __dbg, c = d.city, P = d.player, E = c.edges, N = c.nodes; let best = null, bd = 1e18; for (const e of E) { if (!/^Conestoga Parkway/.test(e.name || '') || e.elev) continue; const a = N[e.a], b = N[e.b]; const mx = (a.x + b.x) / 2 + 1907, mz = (a.z + b.z) / 2 - 3058; const q = mx * mx + mz * mz; if (q < bd) { bd = q; best = e; } } const a = N[best.a], b = N[best.b], L = Math.hypot(b.x - a.x, b.z - a.z), ux = (b.x - a.x) / L, uz = (b.z - a.z) / L; const off = (best.hw || 7) + 6; P.x = (a.x + b.x) / 2 + uz * off; P.z = (a.z + b.z) / 2 - ux * off; P.y = c.groundAt(P.x, P.z, null); P.heading = Math.atan2(ux, uz) - 0.3; P.camYaw = P.heading + Math.PI; P.camPos.set(P.x + Math.sin(P.camYaw) * 4.6, P.y + 1.6, P.z + Math.cos(P.camYaw) * 4.6); })()
